title: Suspended-game grading counted the resumed portion (production scorer, mid-game check, shadow graders, live-forward resolver, calibration monitors)
tier_reason: the production streak scorer could grade a pick from resumed-portion activity (local state impact class; no firing evidenced), and the fix's clause-C grading — pre-suspension at-bats without a hit graded miss where the pinned rules give a Pass — is unfixed and reaches production grading (I-201)

contract.text: A pick in a suspended game is graded on game activity up to the suspension only; the resumed or re-scheduled portion of a suspended MLB game is never evaluated for BTS.
contract.source: official rules §6 'Regarding Suspended Games' (docs/audit/2026-09-29-incident-register-evidence/rules/section6.txt); ARCHITECTURE.md 'Suspended-game scoring'; CLAUDE.md safety rule (read_pa_for_bts_scoring)

mechanism.text: MLB files all of a suspended-then-resumed game's PA (pre-suspension and resumed) under the original officialDate and its final boxscore is cumulative; the processed PA carried no marker for the resumed portion, so no consumer could exclude it

feed-based graders graded from the cumulative final boxscore — the production streak scorer (check_hit / _check_hit_in_game), the scheduler's mid-game hit check, and the shadow graders that call the same checker (skip_policy_shadow, the shadow-backfill cached-feed path) — so a resumed-portion hit could advance the streak and a batter present only in the resumed portion was graded instead of void

parquet-based consumers took max(is_hit) over a suspended game's full PA — the live-forward resolver and the (batter_id, date) day-hit lookups in model/calibrate, health/realized_calibration, health/slate_auc and scripts/canonicalize_realized_picks — crediting resumed-portion hits to original-gameday rows and calibration labels

verified_recovered.how: the 7/01 production-state audit read the production pa_2026.parquet: is_resumed_portion present, with game 824912 split into scoreable and resumed rows

residual.text: Clause C: a pick with pre-suspension at-bats but no hit is graded miss, while the pinned rules make it a Pass (design §10.1: HEAD 'miss', required 'void'); tests/test_check_hit_suspension.py::test_grade_resumed_hit_does_not_count is recorded there as conflicting coverage.
residual.source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-29-incident-register-design.md §10.1; rules section6.txt clause C; ARCHITECTURE.md 'Suspended-game scoring' (I-201)

residual.text: Offline research paths still read raw PA including the resumed portion (falsification-harness CLI diagnostics, ~0.06% of 2026 rows; research/audit scripts) — not production scoring.

watchdog.trigger: at the 01:00 grading run and on any regrade, for each graded slot whose game feed has gameData.datetime.resumeDateTime: the stored grade differs from a pre-suspension-only regrade of the same feed (plays with startTime < resumeDateTime; no pre-suspension PA → void)
watchdog.recovery_assertion: stored slot results and their streak effect equal the pre-suspension-only grade for every suspended-game pick; a mismatch is corrected and alerted

evidence.what: the production scorer read the cumulative final boxscore hit total, which includes the resumed portion, so a resumed-portion hit could falsely continue a streak
the live-forward resolver and the day-hit lookups in calibrate, realized_calibration and canonicalize_realized_picks took max(is_hit) over a suspended game's full PA
Codex review round 1: scheduler._check_hits_midgame read cumulative boxscore hits, health/slate_auc built labels from raw max(is_hit), and build marked a missing-startTime PA pre-suspension
a suspended-then-resumed game keeps its original officialDate so all its PA file under the earlier date, and nothing in the processed PA distinguished the resumed portion
the skip-policy shadow checker and the shadow-backfill cached-feed path collapsed a suspended-game void to miss via the bool checker; both switched to the three-valued grade
resumed or re-scheduled activity is never evaluated; a suspended game where the player has no hit at the time of suspension is a Pass
suspended, pre-suspension AB without a hit (clause C): HEAD grades miss, the required grade is void — strict expected-failure fixture
